title: I graded 36 popular MCP servers on agent usability. A third got a D or F
summary: A technical analysis where the author evaluated 36 popular MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for their compatibility and usability with AI agents, discovering that approximately one-third of them received poor grades (D or F), indicating significant integration challenges for agent-based applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of standardized quality assessment for MCP servers when used in AI agent workflows, identifying which servers fail to meet basic agent usability requirements.
why_valuable: Provides empirical data to help developers make informed decisions about which MCP servers to integrate, while highlighting common pitfalls that server maintainers should avoid to improve agent compatibility.
